title: Continuing Professional License
source_file: View Policy LICN-024_ Continuing Professional License _ NC State Board of Education.html

blocks.text: This Policy establishes the qualifications and procedures for obtaining a continuing professional license.
To qualify for a continuing professional teacher license, an applicant must:
blocks.heading: Teacher License

blocks.text: Hold an initial professional educator license or residency license in North Carolina;
blocks.label: (a)

blocks.text: Satisfy the applicable licensure examination requirements before or during the third year of licensure, provided that the applicant must attempt the examinations at least once during the first year of licensure if the applicant did not satisfy the examination requirements before receiving an IPL;
blocks.label: (b)

blocks.text: Have at least three years of licensed teaching experience; and
blocks.label: (c)

blocks.text: Have completed a Beginning Teacher Support Program, as provided in TCED-016, unless the applicant either:
blocks.label: (d)

blocks.text: Has at least three years of licensed teaching experience outside of North Carolina; or
blocks.label: (i)

blocks.text: Previously held a CPL that reverted to an IPL in accordance with LICN-030.
blocks.label: (ii)

blocks.text: To qualify for a continuing professional administrator or student services personnel license, an applicant must:
blocks.heading: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License
blocks.section: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License

blocks.text: Satisfy the applicable licensure examination requirements before or during the third year of licensure, provided that the applicant must attempt the examinations at least once during the first year of licensure if the applicant did not satisfy the examination requirements before receiving an IPL; and
blocks.label: (a)
blocks.section: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License

blocks.text: Meet other requirements for the license provided by LICN-011 or LICN-012.
blocks.label: (b)
blocks.section: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License

blocks.text: To qualify for a CPL based on possession of a clear license in another jurisdiction, an applicant must meet the requirements of LICN-025.
blocks.section: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License

blocks.text: A CPL shall entitle the licensee to practice as an independent professional educator in North Carolina.
blocks.section: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License

blocks.text: A CPL shall remain in effect for five years after the licensee retires from full-time employment as a professional educator.
blocks.section: Administrator or Student Services Personnel License
